metric_reason: The prior structural score was too binary and was replaced with a process score tied to a real ratchet report.

trust_signals: Score history now carries per-cycle before and after totals plus split sub-scores.
Artifacts are checked for freshness and ledger alignment instead of field presence alone.
problems_found: The old score treated field presence as proof and could not distinguish running from plateau states.
The ledger artifact was not valid JSONL, so cycle counting was untrustworthy.
repair_actions: Tightened the report schema with metric review and stop evidence structures.
Made the scorer validate freshness, mutable-surface boundaries, and iteration alignment.

stop_reason: plateau after two consecutive non-improving cycles

score_history.summary: Repaired the scorer and schema so real cycle evidence, freshness, and boundary checks influence the metric.
A bounded prompt-only proposal did not improve the score and was reverted.
